Leftovers are a sauce smear on the plate (about 15 kcal) and about 40 ml of cola (about 17 kcal), roughly 30 kcal in total.

Eaten is therefore about 675 kcal.

For macronutrients, the cannelloni eaten (about 585 kcal) gives roughly 30 g protein, 50 g carbohydrate and 28 g fat. The cola adds about 22 g carbohydrate. Totals eaten come to about 30 g protein, 72 g carbohydrate and 28 g fat.
